resources.string: SimHub sends the game car\'s position, speed and gear to Apple Maps; the iPhone falls back to its own GPS when the game stops. This tablet sends its precise Android location. Applies on the next connection: the iPhone reads it when CarPlay connects.
CarPlay follows the game\'s day and night instead of the tablet\'s. Without game data it follows the tablet.

Shows the game car\'s fuel level and range in Apple Maps. rigPlay tells CarPlay the rig is an electric car, so Maps may treat it as one. Starts on the next connection once SimHub has sent fuel and range.
